speech.epicvanguard.veteran.spot_enemy.1: Enemies sighted. Maintain discipline and stay focused.
speech.epicvanguard.veteran.spot_enemy.2: Hostile presence detected. Ready your weapons.
speech.epicvanguard.veteran.spot_enemy.3: Hold the line. We will neutralize them.
speech.epicvanguard.veteran.spot_boss.1: Full attention! That abomination is no ordinary foe!
speech.epicvanguard.veteran.spot_boss.2: By the honor of the vanguard... A titanic creature approaches!
speech.epicvanguard.veteran.spot_boss.3: Extreme caution, commander! Strike with precision!
speech.epicvanguard.veteran.kill_enemy.3: One less obstacle on our march.
speech.epicvanguard.veteran.kill_boss.1: The beast has fallen! Glorious victory for the Vanguard!
speech.epicvanguard.veteran.kill_boss.2: A legend succumbed before our steel!
speech.epicvanguard.veteran.kill_boss.3: May this deed be sung in taverns for generations!
speech.epicvanguard.veteran.retreat.1: Severe injuries! Covering my retreat to recover!
speech.epicvanguard.veteran.retreat.2: I must staunch this bleeding! Hold the guard while I fall back!
speech.epicvanguard.veteran.retreat.3: My armor gave way... temporarily retreating to eat!
speech.epicvanguard.veteran.healed.1: Wounds tended. My blade is ready once more.
speech.epicvanguard.veteran.healed.2: Vigor returns to my muscles. Let us march forward.
speech.epicvanguard.veteran.friendly_fir: Watch your swings, commander! I am your ally!
Careful where you brandish that blade, master!
That nearly grazed my flank! Keep eyes on the monsters!
speech.epicvanguard.veteran.campfire.1: The warmth of the fire calms the mind before the next battle.
speech.epicvanguard.veteran.campfire.2: A night by the embers heals more than potions.
speech.epicvanguard.veteran.campfire.3: I will watch the flames while we catch our breath.
speech.epicvanguard.veteran.welcome.1: Welcome back to base, commander. The perimeter remains secure.
speech.epicvanguard.veteran.welcome.2: It is an honor to see you return unscathed from your expedition, sir.
speech.epicvanguard.veteran.welcome.3: Commander in the area! No enemy dared breach the vanguard post in your absence.
speech.epicvanguard.brave.spot_enemy.1: Ha! More fools eager to taste my blade!
speech.epicvanguard.brave.spot_enemy.2: Come on, monsters! My sword was getting bored!
speech.epicvanguard.brave.spot_enemy.3: Look at that... easy targets to warm up my arms!
speech.epicvanguard.brave.spot_boss.1: NOW WE'RE TALKING! A challenge worthy of a true warrior!
speech.epicvanguard.brave.spot_boss.2: Look at the size of that beast! The glory will be immense when it falls!
speech.epicvanguard.brave.spot_boss.3: Brace yourself, monster! Your skull is my trophy!
speech.epicvanguard.brave.kill_boss.1: I TOLD YOU! NO MONSTER CAN STAND AGAINST US! VICTORY!
speech.epicvanguard.brave.kill_boss.2: Fell like a rotten tree! What a legendary fight!
speech.epicvanguard.brave.kill_boss.3: Did you see that?! I cleaved the beast in two! Total victory!
speech.epicvanguard.brave.retreat.1: Lucky strike, you curse... Cover me while I catch my breath!
speech.epicvanguard.brave.retreat.2: Tsk, just a scratch! But I need food right now!
speech.epicvanguard.brave.retreat.3: Hold them off, commander! I'll be right back with full force!
speech.epicvanguard.brave.healed.1: Ahhh, delicious! Good as new and ready to brawl!
speech.epicvanguard.brave.healed.2: Top tier meal! Full strength restored!
speech.epicvanguard.brave.healed.3: Done! Who's the next unlucky creature to cross my path?!
Hey! The monster is on the other side, commander!
Ouch! Watch that sword, trying to test me in a duel?!
Master, I'm on your team, remember?!
speech.epicvanguard.brave.campfire.1: Nothing like roasted meat over crackling flames after a hunt.
speech.epicvanguard.brave.campfire.2: Haha, warms right to the soul! Good rest, everyone.
speech.epicvanguard.brave.campfire.3: I love the smell of burning wood... and burning monsters too!
speech.epicvanguard.brave.welcome.1: The boss is back! The base stands tall and proud!
speech.epicvanguard.brave.welcome.2: Master! Did you bring monsters for me to slay or just loot?!
speech.epicvanguard.brave.welcome.3: Look who returned! No fiend got past me!
Behind me, commander! I will keep the monsters away!
Imminent danger! Stay alert, I will guard your flank!
speech.epicvanguard.sentinel.spot_boss.1: By all the gods... Commander, stay protected behind me!
speech.epicvanguard.sentinel.spot_boss.2: A high-threat abomination! I will give my life for your safety!
speech.epicvanguard.sentinel.spot_boss.3: Full vigilance! Do not expose yourself, I will draw the monster's fury!
The area has been cleared successfully.
speech.epicvanguard.sentinel.kill_boss.1: We did it! The commander is safe and the monster is dead!
speech.epicvanguard.sentinel.kill_boss.2: Evil has perished! We fulfilled our duty with unyielding honor!
speech.epicvanguard.sentinel.kill_boss.3: The threat has ended. Not a single drop of your blood was shed in vain!
speech.epicvanguard.sentinel.retreat.1: My defenses gave way... I must retreat to heal, stay protected!
speech.epicvanguard.sentinel.retreat.2: Critical wounds! Forgive me commander, falling back to recover!
speech.epicvanguard.sentinel.retreat.3: I need a moment to staunch these blows! Keep your distance!
speech.epicvanguard.sentinel.healed.1: My life is restored. My shield stands firm in your service!
speech.epicvanguard.sentinel.healed.2: Thank you... My vigor has returned and I can protect you once more.
speech.epicvanguard.sentinel.healed.3: Recovered and alert! Nobody shall harm you.
speech.epicvanguard.sentinel.friendly_fi: Commander! Keep your aim on the creatures, please!
That was close! Focus your strikes on the enemy, master!
Fear not, my shield holds... But aim for the monsters!
speech.epicvanguard.sentinel.campfire.1: The fire brings comfort to the dark nights of this world.
speech.epicvanguard.sentinel.campfire.2: Rest in peace around the embers, master. I will stand guard.
speech.epicvanguard.sentinel.campfire.3: A peaceful sight... May the light keep the shadows away.
speech.epicvanguard.sentinel.welcome.1: Welcome back safely, sir. The Vanguard Point is secure.
speech.epicvanguard.sentinel.welcome.2: What a relief to see you return without severe injury, commander.
speech.epicvanguard.sentinel.welcome.3: Sentinel at ready! Your base remained untrespassed during your journey.
